brief: A high-energy 14-second promo trailer that tours the real Neon Casino blackjack site: it opens on the landing hero, scrolls down the live table and betting UI while a cursor glides in and clicks chips, then fires spotlight callouts over Play now, the live table, and the PAY HERE chip action before landing on a full-screen end card with the site URL - one continuous scroll-through with spotlight callouts as the single dominant motion idea, unnarrated, motion is the message.

end_card.style: logo-outro lockup language: chip-mark + wordmark + URL pill

highlights.label: Play now — one tap to the table
Chip action over the hero fan
Live table setup — choose your seat

motion.beats: 0.0s hook (scale_punch on hero title) / 3s scroll lands setup + cursor click-ripple on Play now + spotlight wipe / 7s scroll lands rules + spotlight + callout pops / 11s end-card URL glow / 14s fade_out
motion.primitives: scroll pan (scroll-camera-story pass) · spotlight/dim wipe-in via yt-feather-highlight (never pre-applied) · cursor move + press-ripple click via oversized-cursor/press-ripple · scale_punch callout pins via hw-callout-circle after zoom lands · glow on URL · hold_breath on readable beats (>=0.3s each)

end_card.style: logo-outro lockup language: chip-mark + wordmark + URL pill

style: neon-casino promo matching the site: dark felt green + gold, high energy
